tasks.title: Implement system configuration center
tasks.description: Add a secure configuration service, validated API endpoints, runtime compatibility, and a five-section Web configuration page.
success_criteria: Development and desktop runtimes resolve the correct .env path
ZhiQiu accounts support JSON with legacy fallbacks
Five configuration sections can be read and updated without leaking secrets
Configuration writes are atomic and preserve unrelated .env content
Runtime-safe values hot reload while database changes require restart
Focused unit, API, frontend, and browser verification pass
